column1: # corpus-external.tsv — pinned truth for the NOT-vendored external corpora.
# Generated by `cargo run --release -p xtask -- gen-external-manifest` from a
# real budget-free run — never hand-edited. Columns: status<TAB>sha256<TAB>path
#   match  — decoded, text equals the sibling .txt ground truth
#   decode — decoded, no ground truth exists (gallery images)
#   wrong  — decoded, text differs from ground truth (miscorrection class)
#   aux    — not an image (ground truth / metadata), hash-pinned only
# `corpus-report --external` re-measures and fails on ANY divergence:
# a regression and a capability gained both exit 1 (flip pins deliberately).
